title: Turn View
description: The front camera in the instrument cluster with a turn card and, near each turn, a blue turn sign (three chevrons pointing the way), from BMW Maps, Apple CarPlay or Android Auto; the camera shows with or without a route. Or on the head unit instead: the Camera button opens the camera's whole picture with the same card and sign, at any speed (Picture on: Head unit), for kerbs and tight gaps. iDrive 8: pick "Turn View AR" in the cluster's widget menu (from the car's next start after installing). iDrive 7: off at every start of the car; switch it on in this app and set Instrument cluster > Centra
